subject: math
note: Illustrative catalogs only (R8 pilot, kept as-is by ADR-005): neither is a real textbook and neither carries a publisher, revision or edition line, because no book or chapter below was checked against a published table of contents. They now follow the real volumes by order (3 and 4): the two PEP catalogs in pep-math-2022.json and pep-math-9b-legacy.json take 1 and 2, so the directory opens on actual textbooks and the examples sit after them. The tree lives here, at subject level, so a tool's curriculum.json only places a tool into a chapter and several tools may share one chapter. Catalog B deliberately orders the same two conceptual chapters the other way round to prove that order belongs to the catalog, not to the tool.
